svg.title: 03. Standing shin stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Hold the support. Put most of your weight on one foot. Place the top of the other toes on the ground just behind you. Keep light toe contact and move that leg forwards a little.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://www.verywellfit.com/shin-stretches-standing-stetch-3436425
